description: This file contains the implementation of the Customer class within the OpenCart system, specifically for the Catalog Startup namespace. It defines the Customer class, which extends the base Controller class and manages customer-related initialization, such as setting the customer object in the registry and configuring the customer group ID based on session or login status.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class responsible for customer initialization during startup, setting up customer object and customer group ID based on session or login state.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer object and sets the customer group ID configuration based on session data or logged-in customer information.
